shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 2 'app shell|navigation|router|uikit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- TRAPS ---\\n' && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && printf '\\n--- APP ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- MAIN ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/navigation']) {try {console.log(p,require(p+'/package.json').version)} catch(e) {console.log(p,'missing')}}\" && npm install @gravity-ui/navigation"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider Text useTheme'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider Text useTheme'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'AsideHeader|menuItems|renderContent|ThemeProvider|Switch|Card|Button|Required setup' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/Switch/Switch.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/icons && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch && sed -n '44,76p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && rg -n 'export interface MenuItem|interface MenuItem|icon\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types/*.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && rg -n 'interface MenuItem|type MenuItem|icon\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -30 && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"ChartPie, Gear, House, Moon, Sun\", \"ChartPie, Gear, House, Sun\")
s=s.replace('size={18}', 'width={18} height={18}').replace('size={20}', 'width={20} height={20}')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/ChartPie, Gear, House, Moon, Sun/ChartPie, Gear, House, Sun/; s/size={18}/width={18} height={18}/g; s/size={20}/width={20} height={20}/g' src/App.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git status --short && git diff --stat'
